settings.title: Activity Types
settings.subtitle: The behavior catalog offered to study participants via cue configs.
settings.catalogDesc: Platform-wide catalog of activity types that study participants can choose from when creating a habit. Activities marked as default are pre-selected for study groups without an explicit behavior restriction. Study groups can restrict or expand the list via their Cue Config. Public (non-study) users enter their habit as free text and do not use this catalog.
settings.keyHint: The key must be lowercase with underscores (e.g. strength_training). It is auto-normalised from what you type.
settings.keyAndLabelRequired: Key and English label are required.
settings.confirmDelete: Delete activity type "{key}"? This cannot be undone.

backups.title: Backups
backups.subtitle: View the last backup, trigger one on demand, or restore from an existing or uploaded archive. Restoring is destructive — a safety backup is always taken first.

phase.preRestoreSafety: Taking a safety backup before restoring…

backups.destructiveWarning: This is destructive. It will overwrite the current MongoDB, Neo4j, and LightRAG data{keycloak, select, yes { and reimport the Keycloak realm} other {}}. A safety backup of the current state is taken automatically first — if it fails, the restore will not proceed.
backups.knownIssuesWarning: This backup has known issues: {components} failed when it was created.
backups.reimportKeycloakLabel: Also reimport the Keycloak realm from this file (off by default for uploaded archives — a malicious realm export could grant an attacker admin access)

participants.title: Participants
participants.subtitle: Create and manage study participants, reassign groups, and inspect progress.
participants.keycloakSubTooltip: Keycloak sub — the id all habits, logs and donations are keyed by
participants.saveCredentialsNow: Save these credentials now — the password is not shown again.
participants.noAnswerContent: No stored answer content for this response.
participants.recoveryPhraseDesc: The 24-word phrase this participant uses to restore their account. Handle it like a password.
participants.fastForwardDesc: Shifts this participant's timeline back so upcoming questionnaire windows, logs and SRHI become due now. Dev-only — the app re-syncs due tasks and reminders on next open.
participants.confirmAnonymise: Anonymise participant "{username}"? This cannot be undone.
participants.ffAdvanced: Advanced {days} day(s). Open the app to re-sync.

cuePools.title: Cue Pools
cuePools.subtitle: Manage pre-rated contextual cues for study conditions.
cuePools.qualityHint: High-quality cues are shown to the high_quality condition; low to the low_quality condition.
cuePools.domainHint: The activity domain this cue relates to (e.g. physical_activity).
cuePools.languageHint: The language this cue is written in — used to match participant locale.
cuePools.stabilityHint: How temporally consistent this cue is across days. 5 = very stable.
cuePools.salienceHint: How noticeable or attention-grabbing this cue is. 5 = highly salient.
cuePools.specificityHint: How concrete and specific this cue context is. 5 = very specific.
cuePools.csvHeaderError: CSV must have a header row and at least one data row.
cuePools.importedCues: Imported {count, plural, one {# cue} other {# cues}}
cuePools.emptyState: No cues yet. Click "{addCue}" to create one.

donations.title: Habit Donations
donations.subtitle: Donated habits across participants. Filter and export for analysis.

insights.title: Insights
insights.subtitle: Frequently-asked questions across MongoDB and Neo4j, cached and refreshed on demand.

defaultApp.title: Public App
defaultApp.subtitle: Default experience for users who open the app without a study code.

features.sectionDesc: Which features are active for public users.
features.guidedWizardHint: When enabled, public users are taken through a step-by-step wizard (habit → cues → LLM stitch → confirm → reminder). Habit and cues are always free text for public users; disabling this only skips the LLM stitching step.
features.communitySharingLabel: Community sharing opt-in shown by default
features.communitySharingHint: When enabled, the community sharing toggle appears at the end of habit creation and is pre-selected.

defaults.sectionDesc: Public users create their habits with free-text entry — cue and behavior configuration exists only per study group (Studies → Cue Config).
defaults.reminderTimeHint: Time of day for the daily check-in push notification. Users can override in their profile.

profileFields.title: Profile Fields
profileFields.subtitle: Configure which fields appear in the onboarding profile setup.

knowledgeBase.title: Knowledge Base
knowledgeBase.subtitle: Manage PDF papers used for habit recommendations. Grouped by category.
knowledgeBase.emptyState: No PDFs in the knowledge base yet. Click "Upload PDF" to add one.
knowledgeBase.fileTypeError: Only PDF, TXT, and MD files are accepted.
knowledgeBase.confirmDeleteText: You are about to permanently delete {filename} from the knowledge base. This action cannot be undone.

questionnaires.noQuestionsYet: No questions yet. Click "Add question" to begin.
questionnaires.deleteConfirmText: You are about to delete {title}. This action cannot be undone.

cueConfigForm.cueCountHint: Single: one cue per habit-formation session. Multi: several cues presented together.
cueConfigForm.cueSourceHint: How cues are sourced — pre-rated from the cue pool library, or chosen by the participant themselves.
cueConfigForm.maxHabitsHint: Caps how many habits a participant can create. Use "1" for single-habit study designs.
cueConfigForm.allowedBehaviorsHint: Which activity types participants can choose from. Manage the catalog under Configuration → Activity Types.

activityTypesManager.title: Activity type catalog (shared across studies)
activityTypesManager.description: Behaviors participants can pick from when a group restricts its allowed behaviors below. Defaults are pre-selected for groups with no explicit restriction. Free-entry (public) users don't use this catalog.
activityTypesManager.keyAndLabelRequired: Key and English label are required.
activityTypesManager.confirmDelete: Delete activity type "{key}"? This cannot be undone.

accessDenied.title: Access Denied
accessDenied.message: You do not have permission to access the admin panel. Only users with the admin or researcher role can log in.

studies.title: Studies
studies.subtitle: Manage studies, groups, and participant enrolment.

table.noStudiesYet: No studies yet. Click "{button}" to create one.

fields.nameHint: Used internally; not visible to participants.
fields.recommenderHint: When disabled, participants in this study do not see the recommender screen in the app.
fields.onboardingLabel: Show habit-creation onboarding for this study
fields.onboardingHint: When disabled, participants skip the first-time explainer screens (what a habit is, what cues are) when creating a habit. Can be overridden per group below.
fields.selfHabitLabel: Allow participants to create their own habits
fields.selfHabitHint: When disabled, participants in this study cannot create new habits themselves. Can be overridden per group below.
fields.remindersHint: When enabled, participants get a reminder notification on the day each questionnaire is due. Turn off to cancel reminders for this study (applied on the participant's next app open).
fields.endDateHint: Optional. When set, the schedule calendar stops projecting occurrences past this date.
fields.endOfStudyHintEnabled: Delivered locally on the participant's device on the end date above.
fields.endOfStudyHintDisabled: Set a study end date above to enable this.
fields.groupCountHint: Each group is a study condition (e.g. control, intervention). Label them below.

confirmDefault.message: Set {name} as the default study? Participants without a study code will be enrolled here.

confirmDelete.message: Delete {name} from the studies list? It will be hidden from the portal, but all of its data is kept in the backend. Download a full copy first if you need it.
confirmDelete.typeNameLabel: Type the study name {name} to confirm:

footer.deactivateDisabledTitle: Cannot deactivate the default study. Set another study as default first.

questionnairesTab.empty: No questionnaires available. Create some in the Questionnaires section.

scheduleTab.noneAssigned: No questionnaires scheduled yet. Add one below.
scheduleTab.appliesToHint: A group assignment overrides the study-wide one for that questionnaire.
scheduleTab.weeksHint: Week 0 = at enrollment (baseline). Each week is a due date.
scheduleTab.daysHint: Exact days after enrollment. Combined with any weeks above.
scheduleTab.calendarHint: Click a day to schedule a questionnaire starting then. Dashed entries are a preview of what a new enrollee would see, not yet real participant data.

calendar.noOccurrences: No scheduled occurrences yet. Click a day above or add an assignment below.

scheduleTab.confirmRemove: Remove this assignment? Scheduled entries not yet answered are removed too.

codesTab.allocationDesc: Controls how study codes distribute participants across conditions. Weights are relative — 2 : 1 : 1 : 1 means the first group gets twice as many participants.
codesTab.generateDesc: Codes are tied to the study. Each participant who redeems one is assigned to a group automatically using the allocation above.
codesTab.quantityHintStudy: How many unique enrollment codes to generate in this batch.
codesTab.maxRedemptionsHint: How many participants can redeem each code. Leave blank for unlimited.
codesTab.expiryHint: Codes stop working after this date and time. Leave blank for no expiry.
codesTab.targetedToggleSub: — pin a code to a specific condition
codesTab.groupHint: Participants who redeem this code are assigned directly to this condition, bypassing the allocation weights.
codesTab.targetedQuantityHint: How many unique codes to generate for this condition.

notificationsTab.targetHint: Send to everyone enrolled in this study or to a specific condition group.
notificationsTab.sendTimeHint: Send immediately or schedule for a future date and time.

cueConfigTab.noGroups: No groups defined. Add groups in the Details tab first.
cueConfigTab.onboardingHint: Overrides the study-level onboarding setting for this group only.
cueConfigTab.selfHabitHint: When off, this group cannot create their own habits.
